content:
Hi,

I am trying to plug-in mathlib to my project on NixOS.
The built-in lake cache is not working there. lake downloads its cache, but rebuilds mathlib on lake build. Nix Cache has lean, lake and mathlib. lake discovers Nix cache, but tries to create .c.o.export files there, which is impossible, because nix dependencies are immutable.

Is this cache incomplete?
Is it possible to skip generation of these files?

https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/550523
